author: Emily Henry
keyCast: Tom Blyth, Emily Bader, Sarah Catherine Hook
notes: Emily Henry's 2021 bestseller tracks Poppy and Alex, platonic best friends who take one vacation together every summer until a disastrous trip two years ago ended their friendship entirely. Now Poppy convinces Alex to try one more getaway to fix what broke between them—a premise that lives or dies on whether Henry can sell the will-they-won't-they tension across a decade of vacations. Brett Haley (All the Bright Places) directs, with Tom Blyth and Emily Bader as the leads and Sarah Catherine Hook in a supporting role. The book works because Henry writes sharp dialogue and understands that adult friendship breakups hurt as much as romantic ones, making this more layered than standard beach-read fare. Read it first—the novel's structure, jumping between past trips and the present reconciliation, creates emotional payoff that a two-hour film will struggle to replicate.
